mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = cart_item.quantity + new.quantity
mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS id, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.price AS productPrice, p.stock AS productStock FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON c.id = ci.cart_id JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ci.id

SELECT ci.id AS id, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.price AS productPrice, p.stock AS productStock FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON c.id = ci.cart_id JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id WHERE ci.id = #{id} AND c.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND cart_id = (SELECT id FROM cart WHERE member_id = #{memberId})
